author: Jason Stys
summary: Show pair/zone coverage ledgers with stale tracks, datum mismatch, unknown intervals and exclusion reasons.
rationale: Explains what an awareness result actually covers instead of implying empty or incomplete data means clear airspace.
limitations: Fictional local-coordinate constant-velocity awareness, not flight permission, collision probability or avoidance control.
Freshness is evaluated at the supplied snapshot, not continuously across the projection.
No declared pairs or modeled overlap does not prove clear airspace; undeclared objects and incompatible altitude references remain unknown.
Source-first project with current package/service validation; no public native desktop application release is supplied.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
